_about: Sound effects for the characters and creatures already in the game (AUD-05, AUD-06), made with the
ElevenLabs Sound Effects API by tools/voice/sfx.py. Non-verbal only: efforts, pain, death, growls,
footsteps. Spoken barks with words need designed voices (AUD-02, AUD-03) and are a separate job.
Each sound: prompt, seconds (always set, so the cost is known: 40 credits per second per take),
takes (how many variants), and optional loop / influence. 'voice' is prepended to that character's
vocal prompts; 'style' is appended to every prompt. Files go to assets/audio/sfx/<group>/<sound>_<n>.mp3.
Changing a prompt, seconds or influence makes that sound generate again; otherwise it's skipped.
style: Single isolated sound effect, close-mic, dry, no music, no background noise, no reverb tail.
